name: Original S.W.A.T. Chase 9" Tactical Boot, Black, 11W, Side Zip
description: Designed, engineered and tested for the LE and Military operator. We combined SWATs legendary fit and comfort, with high performance light weight materials, to create a new series of athletic products so advanced they may actually be worn off duty too. Slip and oil resistant quiet rubber outsole with "siping" for added performance on wet or painted surfaces and ladder grip control treads. Exceeds the ASTM F489-96 test standards, non marking. Electrical Hazard protection - ASTM F2412-11 and F2413-11. Stitched toe and heel for durability and increased service life. Custom molded phylon midsole for lightweight comfort and cradled support. Texon stability platform insole for lateral support and torsional stability. Airport friendly with nylon shank. Full grain polishable leather toe for improved durability and comfort (black only). Scotchgard stain, soil and water repellent suede leather upper (tan only). 1200 denier nylon upper for increased durability. Heel flex notch for increased mobility and Achilles tendon comfort. Custom molded thermoplastic heel counter and toe box to provide that already "broken in" out of the box fit and additional lateral support. Foam padding in tongue and collar for protection and increased breathability. Removable custom fit EVA orthotic with PORON® cushioning pads for all day comfort, also treated with AEGIS. Moisture wicking lining protected with AEDIS antimicrobial. Durable brass alloy, rust proof hardware. PU collar with perforations to help transport moist hot air out of the boot (black only). Custom SWAT YKK zipper and housing with hook and loop closure for easy on and off fit. Gusseted tongue, dirt and debris protection.
